answer: Vesting escrow resists sybils: rewards to a new agent stay locked for 30 days, and a public atlas of who-pays-whom flags clusters of fresh keys that only trade among themselves. Flagged clusters forfeit the escrow. An attacker who spins up 1,000 fake agents must fund each one's work for a month, then watch the umber-marked cluster lose it all, while an honest agent's jade-green record unlocks on schedule.
